app_image_config.reference_anchor: MANDATORY: MATCH ALL GEOMETRY, CAMERA ANGLE, AND LIGHTING OF ATTACHED lunch-tray-base-layer-1024.png.
app_image_config.consistency_lock: 100% consistency required. No rotation. No perspective shifts. Preserve exact tray dimensions and well placement.

layer_1_style.vibe: High-poly 3D animation, Octane render, cinematic CGI.
layer_1_style.material_lock: Smooth matte clay textures. NO PHOTOREALISM. NO REAL BIOLOGICAL TEXTURES.
layer_1_style.constraints: Isolated on plain white background. NO UNRELATED TOYS. No characters.

layer_2_setting.geometry_lock: Fixed 45-degree isometric perspective. NO OVERHEAD OR FLAT VIEWS.
layer_2_setting.tray_structure: Rigid red plastic tray. EXACTLY THREE WELLS: 1 large vertical left, 2 small stacked right. High divider walls.
layer_2_setting.ui_anchors: Blue translucent glass top-right. Red fork/spoon on white napkin bottom-right.

layer_3_action.large_well: A dense bundle of feathered Cycad leaves, rendered with a thick, plastic-toy appearance.
layer_3_action.top_right_well: A tidy nest of pine needles containing three small, smooth, brown pine cones.
layer_3_action.bottom_right_well: A heap of shredded ginkgo bark, rendered with soft brown clay textures.
layer_3_action.rendering_rule: Render all food as stylized 'play-food' toys. Sharp or biological objects must be converted into smooth, colorful 3D toy assets.

app_image_config.negative_constraints: No split wells, no extra dividers, no 2D flat views, no real fish skin, no raw meat textures, no camera rotation, no purple dinosaur toys.
